reason: Primary purpose is agent automation orchestration: a dsh Cordis plugin that adds control-loop governance around tool calling. It focuses on preventing runaway behavior via pre-execution guardrails, post-execution feedback, adaptive throttling, and controllability checks, with status/snapshot/check helper tools for operator visibility. It is a control/automation utility rather than a UI, content, or file-editing feature.

capabilities: Intercepts and influences dsh tool-call lifecycle events
Can preflight-filter or require confirmation for risky commands
Applies adaptive rate/threshold controls based on observed failure signals
Collects execution telemetry in local logs and exposes status/diagnostic tools

reasons.code: README describes hooks on tools/pre-execute, tools/result, and agent/pre-step used for preflight control, feedback adjustment, and warning injection.
Plugin includes rule-based interception for irreversible actions (e.g., rm/mv/git push) with dry-run+confirm or block behaviors.
Failure estimation uses EMA filtering and escalates/de-escalates control modes, then enforces per-turn tool-call limits.
State and observed tools are written to local persistence files (state_log.ndjson/observed_tools.json), creating operational telemetry side effects.
